lines: Closed-SIP rule change applied as 041f0f7b 'fixup! feat(admin-growth): wire per-investment growth to the V4 operations' on top of 48214037, no rebase.

ENDED_SIP_LABEL is gone. isTargetable() is now: not reversed and amountPaise > 0, whatever the label. It drives One investor's Target list and the sheet rows, so a SIP closed without an exit that still holds money is offered and sent; amountPaise '0' is left out.
A 400 for an exited SIP that still shows an invested amount is shown through the existing rejection path with the server's message; no special case.

WIRING LEFT: investmentGrowthApi.ts holds the V4 port (preview, commit, individual) and its default UNWIRED_INVESTMENT_GROWTH_API. Swap the three port calls (or the context default) for api.request(generatedOp, ...) and replace the local zod body schemas with the generated ones. getAdminClientInvestments (V1) is already wired for real.
ASSUMED V4 REQUESTS: POST /v1/admin/investment-growth/preview body {fundId, growthBasisPoints:int} | {fundId, items:[{userId, ref, gainSinceInvestedPaise}] (1..500)}; no idempotency key.
POST /v1/admin/investment-growth/commit body = preview body + {basisHash:64 hex, effectiveDate:YYYY-MM-DD, reasonCode, note?}; Idempotency-Key header.

POST /v1/admin/investment-growth/individual body {userId, fundId, ref, effectiveDate, reasonCode, note?, growthBasisPoints:int | growthPaise:non-zero signed paise}; Idempotency-Key; NO basisHash (no source for one in V1's read; if V4 requires it, add a per-fund basisHash to a read).
ref = {kind:'sip',scheduleId} | {kind:'one_time',allocationId} (same as V1 AdminInvestmentRef).

ASSUMED V4 RESPONSES: preview {fundId, mode:'percentage'|'gain_since_invested', basisHash, targetCount, totalDeltaPaise, entries:[{userId, beforePaise, deltaPaise, afterPaise, parts:[{ref, label, investedPaise, beforePaise, deltaPaise, afterPaise}]}], skipped:[{userId, reason:'categorise_first'|'zero_invested'}]}.
commit {batchId, fundId, mode, effectiveDate, targetCount, totalDeltaPaise, entries (as preview)}.

individual = today's AdminIndividualClientGrowthData fields (batchId, entryId, userId, fundId, effectiveDate, reasonCode, principalPaise, beforePaise, currentValuePaise, deltaPaise, growthPaise, afterPaise, newValuePaise) + part:{ref,label,investedPaise,beforePaise,deltaPaise,afterPaise}, so GrowthReceipt renders unchanged.
Assumed: server omits zero-change parts; entry.deltaPaise = sum(parts) (client refuses a preview otherwise); part label is display text built by the server.

V1 SHAPE LIMITS (verified at 9e24efe9): items are {ref,label,date|null,amountPaise,reversed}. No per-investment value and no active/ended flag. So: sheet rows show invested + fund value now (no per-investment gain before preview); one-investor shows invested, change and position before/after, and investment before/after only on the receipt (from part).
Ended SIPs cannot be filtered client-side; they are listed as targets and V4 must refuse them (Review Focus 2). Reversed items are hidden.

Categorise first = the fund has any uncategorised recording (or the client has no V1 fund entry / no live investment). This also blocks a fund holding one uncategorised recording, which spec 6.4 would let take untargeted growth; the new endpoints need a ref, so it was the conservative reading. Question for V4.

Sheet fund rate semantics: 'Fund return since invested' in bp fills each row's GAIN SINCE INVESTED with invested x rate (applyBasisPoints = backend symmetricHalfUpBasisPoints); it is cumulative, not the month's change. Min -10000 bp, no upper cap. Overrides typed as gain since invested; commit sends gainSinceInvestedPaise per ref.

Sheet reads getAdminClientInvestments once per client in the fund (useQueries, N requests, ~100 at most). Any failed read shows 'Sheet not loaded' with Reload, never a shorter sheet. A fund-scoped read in V4 would remove the N requests.

Held-write slots kept (value-update, collective-growth, growth:<userId>). A hold saved by 0.18.3 with the old body shape now parses as unreadable: the screen locks with the existing unreadable notice, nothing is resent to a new endpoint.
RULE 11: frontend only; no existing request/response shape changes; the cherry-picked V1 contracts add operations only.

The port, InvestmentGrowthApiContext, the unwired refusal and the local body schemas are removed; held writes parse with the contract request bodies; types come from the generated ops.

CONTRACT MISMATCH TO KNOW: f0bce4ed's AdminInvestmentGrowthSkip is {userId, reason: categorise_first|zero_invested}; v-growth-parts 9ce895db (the backend commit) widens it to {userId, ref: AdminInvestmentRef|null, reason: ...|unchanged}. The frontend validates responses strictly, so until 9ce895db's contract is in, a real response carrying ref or 'unchanged' would be refused as malformed. Once V4 lands (contract from 9ce895db), it matches. The UI reads skips through skipsOf() with an optional ref, so it typechecks against both.

Categorise first now mirrors the server: mustCategoriseFirst = fund.status 'preparing' AND investments + uncategorised > 1. A preview whose skipped lists a sent client as categorise_first marks that client 'Categorise first' in the sheet, drops the preview and asks for a new one (warning 'Categorise first'), so a commit never names them. Server 409s show the server message plus the reload hint.

A fund whose only investment is one uncategorised recording: V1 lists it only under uncategorised (no ref), so the sheet row reads 'No investment to target here yet. A whole fund's rate reaches it.' and is never sent; One investor's Target reads 'Its only investment is not categorised yet: use A whole fund'. Targeting it individually needs a ref from V1, which V1 does not give.

Ended SIPs: V1 has no state flag, so isTargetable() filters ref.kind 'sip' with V1 label exactly 'Ended SIP' (adminInvestmentProjection.ts labelOf), plus reversed items. They are never shown as targets or sent. This is fragile to a label change; a state field on the V1 item would be cleaner (later).
Matching: unchanged and zero_invested skips carry a ref and exclude only that row; categorise_first skips (ref null) exclude the client. Part keys must equal the remaining typed rows exactly.
Main's new test 'opens the investor a later link names' (rebased in) now chooses a Target, which is now required; it also asserts ref.
